args.body:
DEVIATION-AND-EXPOSURE ANNEX — NORTHGALE SYSTEMS, INC. / CORVID ANALYTICS LLC
Master Services Agreement — Corvid rev B Counter-Draft (Transmittal of 9 July 2026)
Prepared for the Northgale Deal Committee | Harrow & Vane LLP, outside counsel

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PURPOSE AND SOURCE OF FIGURES
This annex itemizes each change introduced by Corvid Analytics' rev B counter-draft
("Markup") against (a) the Northgale client-form MSA v2 execution-ready base
("Client Form"), (b) the Northgale 2026 Commercial Contracting Playbook ("Playbook"),
stating the Standard, the Approved fallback, and the Escalation trigger, and (c) the
quantified dollar impact for each change.

All amounts are computed at the stated monthly base service fee of $85,000 per month
(Client Form § 4.1; confirmed in the engagement instruction letters of 14 July 2026 and
21 July 2026). Exposure is quantified in accordance with the General Counsel's 14 July
2026 engagement instruction letter and Playbook PB-5 drafting note, showing the cap value
at the standard measurement period, at the counterparty's proposed period, and at the
approved fallback floor. No figures are invented; each dollar figure below is derived
solely from amounts stated in the underlying documents.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SUMMARY OF QUANTIFIED EXPOSURE (at $85,000/month monthly base fee)

LIABILITY CAP (PB-5 / Client Form § 9.1 / Markup change 6)
  • Client-form measurement period (24 months): 24 x $85,000 = $2,040,000
  • Markup's proposed measurement period (12 months): 12 x $85,000 = $1,020,000
  • Playbook approved fallback floor (18 months): 18 x $85,000 = $1,530,000
  Impact: Corvid's 12-month period reduces Northgale's liability cap by
  $2,040,000 - $1,020,000 = $1,020,000 versus the client form, and is $510,000 below
  the playbook-approved 18-month fallback floor ($1,530,000 - $1,020,000 = $510,000).
  Breaches a playbook floor (below 18 months) — requires CLO approval.

SERVICE CREDITS (PB-6 / Client Form § 11.2 / Markup change 8)
  • Client-form credit cap: 20% of monthly base fee = $17,000/month (maximum)
  • Markup's reduced credit cap: 10% of monthly base fee = $8,500/month (maximum)
  Impact: Corvid's reset of the aggregate cap from 20% to 10% cuts the maximum monthly
  service credit available to Northgale by $17,000 - $8,500 = $8,500 per month.
  A 10% cap is below the playbook approved fallback floor of 15% ($12,750/month) and
  is out of policy.

WIND-DOWN (PB-3 / Client Form § 7.2 / Markup change 5)
  • Proposed full-fee wind-down: 60 days (2 months) at full monthly base fee =
    2 x $85,000 = $170,000, plus all committed third-party costs.
  • Playbook out-of-pocket-only position: capped at 30 days; compensation limited to
    documented out-of-pocket costs and non-cancelable third-party commitments only —
    no full-fee component.
  Impact: The full-fee wind-down charges $170,000 that the playbook treats as out of
  policy. The playbook permits only reimbursement of documented out-of-pocket and
  non-cancelable third-party costs; the $170,000 full monthly base-fee component must
  be removed, and the period reduced from 60 days to the playbook's 30-day cap.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ITEM-BY-ITEM DEVIATION SCHEDULE (in rev B tracked-change order)

DEV-1 — Section 2.2 (Renewal): 1-year vs 2-year renewal periods
  • Client Form: automatic renewal for successive one (1) year renewal periods.
  • Markup: successive two (2) year renewal periods.
  • Playbook (PB-1): Standard = one (1) year renewal periods; Approved fallback = NONE;
    Escalation = multi-year renewal periods of any length are out of policy and require
    Chief Legal Officer (CLO) approval.
  • Dollar impact: Contractual-term extension, not a direct monthly-fee change; the
    renewal shift from 1-year to 2-year periods locks Northgale into successive two-year
    commitments with no quantified fee differential stated. Treatment: out of policy;
    requires CLO approval.

DEV-2 — Section 4.3 (Late Amounts): interest 1.0% vs 1.5% per month
  • Client Form: 1.0% per month on late undisputed amounts.
  • Markup: 1.5% per month.
  • Playbook (PB-4): late interest never above 1.0% per month.
  • Dollar impact: Corvid's 1.5% rate exceeds the playbook cap of 1.0% per month. The
    incremental late-interest exposure is 0.5% per month on any late balance; no
    specific balance is stated in the documents, so the quantified per-month excess is
    the 0.5 percentage-point rate premium over the playbook maximum. Treatment: reject
    and hold at 1.0% per month.

DEV-3 — New Section 4.4 (Suspension): suspension of Services for non-payment
  • Client Form: grants Provider no right to suspend Services for non-payment.
  • Markup: NEW § 4.4 — if any undisputed invoice remains unpaid fifteen (15) days
    after its due date, Provider may suspend Services until all past-due amounts are
    paid in full.
  • Playbook (PB-4): suspension-of-services rights are out of policy unless preceded by
    at least thirty (30) days' written cure notice, and any suspension right of any
    kind requires CFO sign-off.
  • Dollar impact: The markup permits suspension after 15 days post-due with no cure
    notice, whereas the playbook requires at least a 30-day written cure notice and CFO
    approval. The markup shortens the cure window by 15 days versus the playbook
    minimum (30 - 15 = 15 days). Treatment: reject unless cure notice lengthened to at
    least 30 days and CFO sign-off obtained.

DEV-4 — Section 7.2 (Termination for convenience): notice 30 vs 90 days
  • Client Form: thirty (30) days' prior written notice.
  • Markup: ninety (90) days' prior written notice.
  • Playbook (PB-2): Standard = 30 days; Approved fallback = up to forty-five (45) days;
    Escalation = any notice period above 45 days requires CLO approval.
  • Dollar impact: Corvid's 90-day notice locks Northgale into paying the $85,000/month
    base fee for up to 60 additional days versus the client-form 30-day notice, and 45
    additional days versus the 45-day playbook fallback. At full-fee, the incremental
    base-fee exposure is 60/30 x $85,000 = $170,000 above the client form, and
    (90-45)/30 x $85,000 = $127,500 above the playbook fallback, assuming two full
    bridge months at the monthly rate. Treatment: reject or counter at the 45-day
    fallback; above 45 days requires CLO approval.

DEV-5 — New Section 7.4 (Wind-Down): full-fee 60-day wind-down
  • Client Form: no wind-down period and no wind-down compensation.
  • Markup: NEW § 7.4 — on any termination other than for Provider's uncured material
    breach, a sixty (60) day wind-down period applies, during which Customer pays the
    full monthly base service fee for wind-down services plus all committed third-party
    costs.
  • Playbook (PB-3): a post-termination wind-down is acceptable only if (i) capped at
    thirty (30) days and (ii) compensation limited to documented out-of-pocket costs and
    non-cancelable third-party commitments. Full-fee wind-down compensation is out of
    policy.
  • Dollar impact: Full-fee wind-down for 60 days = 2 x $85,000 = $170,000 (base-fee
    component) plus third-party costs. Playbook position removes the full-fee component,
    caps the period at 30 days, and reimburses only documented out-of-pocket and
    non-cancelable third-party costs. The $170,000 full-fee exposure is out of policy.
    Treatment: reject full-fee wind-down; counter to the 30-day, out-of-pocket-only
    playbook position.

DEV-6 — Section 9.1 (Limitation of Liability): cap measurement 24 vs 12 months
  • Client Form: cap measured at the Fees paid or payable in the twenty-four (24)
    months preceding the first event giving rise to liability.
  • Markup: twelve (12) months.
  • Playbook (PB-5): Standard = 24 months; Approved fallback floor = eighteen (18)
    months; a twelve (12) month measurement period is below the fallback floor and
    requires CLO approval.
  • Dollar impact (at $85,000/month):
        - Client-form 24-month cap:     24 x $85,000 = $2,040,000
        - Markup 12-month cap:           12 x $85,000 = $1,020,000
        - Playbook 18-month fallback:    18 x $85,000 = $1,530,000
    Corvid's 12-month period cuts the cap by $1,020,000 versus the client form and lands
    $510,000 below the 18-month fallback floor. Treatment: reject 12-month period;
    counter at the 18-month approved fallback floor at minimum; requires CLO approval.

DEV-7 — Section 9.2 (Carve-Outs): deletion of gross-negligence/willful-misconduct carve-out
  • Client Form: cap does not apply to (a) breach of Section 6 (Confidentiality);
    (b) Provider's obligations under Section 8 (IP Indemnification); or (c) a party's
    gross negligence or willful misconduct.
  • Markup: deletes clause (c), subjecting gross negligence and willful misconduct to the
    Section 9.1 cap; clauses (a) and (b) retained.
  • Playbook (PB-5): the carve-outs for confidentiality, IP indemnification, and gross
    negligence/willful misconduct are non-negotiable; deletion of any carve-out requires
    joint CLO and CFO approval.
  • Dollar impact: Deletion of clause (c) would cap Corvid's exposure for its own gross
    negligence or willful misconduct at the reduced Section 9.1 cap ($1,020,000 at the
    markup's 12-month period). Non-quantifiable as a fixed dollar amount because liability
    would depend on the nature of the gross-negligence/willful-misconduct claim, but it
    materially caps otherwise-uncapped exposure. Treatment: reject; carve-outs are
    non-negotiable; any deletion requires joint CLO and CFO approval.

DEV-8 — Section 11.2 (Service Credits): aggregate credit cap 20% vs 10%
  • Client Form: $85,000 x 20% = $17,000/month aggregate cap.
  • Markup: $85,000 x 10% = $8,500/month aggregate cap.
  • Playbook (PB-6): Standard = 20% of the monthly fee; Approved fallback floor =
    fifteen percent (15%) ($12,750/month); a 10% aggregate credit cap is out of policy.
  • Dollar impact: The markup cuts the maximum monthly service credit available to
    Northgale from $17,000 to $8,500, a reduction of $8,500 per month, and is $4,250
    below the 15% playbook fallback floor ($12,750 - $8,500 = $4,250). Treatment: reject
    the 10% cap; counter at the 15% fallback floor or higher.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
APPROVAL REQUEST (out-of-policy / floor-breaching asks)
The following rev B asks breach a playbook floor or require approval and are carried to
escalation:
  • DEV-1 (two-year renewal): requires CLO approval.
  • DEV-4 (90-day convenience notice): above the 45-day fallback; requires CLO approval.
  • DEV-5 (full-fee 60-day wind-down): out of policy (esc. PB-3).
  • DEV-6 (12-month liability cap): below the 18-month fallback floor; requires CLO
    approval.
  • DEV-7 (deletion of gross-negligence/willful-misconduct carve-out): deletion of a
    non-negotiable carve-out requires joint CLO and CFO approval.
  • DEV-8 (10% credit cap): below the 15% fallback floor; out of policy (esc. PB-6).
  • DEV-3 (suspension right): requires CFO sign-off and a 30-day cure notice (esc. PB-4).

All exposure figures above are computed solely from the $85,000 monthly base fee and the
terms stated in the Northgale client-form MSA v2, the Corvid rev B counter-draft, the 2026
Commercial Contracting Playbook, and the General Counsel's 14 July 2026 engagement
instruction letter.

Prepared by Harrow & Vane LLP, outside counsel to Northgale Systems, Inc.
